article_notes: Urinary proteome of 10 dogs with B. canis babesiosis (pooled urine) versus 10 healthy dogs; Table 3 compares urine creatinine, USG, UPC, uRBP/uCr, uTHP/uCr and uIgG/uCr between infected and healthy dogs only. All infected dogs were described as early-phase AKI; there is no comparison within infected dogs by severity or outcome. Nothing to extract. Values were already published elsewhere (authors say so in Methods).
